lines.text: A special event has occurred.
Participate in the event.
Go back.
Today is the day when Emma's cooking competition is being held at the restaurant.
The winner's dish will be incorporated as a mainstay in the menu at Snowfield Hot Spring's restaurant.
I have been appointed to participate as a judge.
When I arrive at the restaurant,
the Nikkes are busy preparing various items for their dishes.
I wonder what they'll end up producing?
You're all a bunch of busy bees.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Welcome, Commander.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm still working on gathering all the ingredients I need.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Lumi?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh, I forgot to tell you this morning.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: When I came to the restaurant this morning to prepare,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I ran into Lumi,

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
I see.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm counting on you two today, hehe.

lines.text: Hey there, Pit Boss.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Uh-huh.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Come on in, Servant.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: We were all thinking about what could be added to the menu,

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: and Emma brought up the idea of a cooking competition.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Personally, I don't think the idea's half bad.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I heard that you're going to be one of the judges.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm counting on your impartiality.
How come you're not a judge?
You run this entire place.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I thought cooking might be more enjoyable than being a judge.

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Anyway, I've got what I need now, so I ought to get back to it.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hey, Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: You betcha!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Belorta encouraged me to partake.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I dunno how well I'll do, but I'm gonna do my best.
I'm sure you'll do great.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Hehe, thanks!
So are the five of you the only ones participating?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: We didn't receive as many applicants as we anticipated.
Looks like you've put a lot of work into this.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: As we should! We are determining what dish will be added to the restaurant's permanent menu, after all.
Could I bother you to explain the rules to me?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's all pretty simple, actually.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: We all have one hour to whip up the best dish we can.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: All you need to focus on is tasting the food and choosing which one you find the most delectable.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Aw jeez... is one hour gonna be enough time?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I have to be very selective with what I want to make.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We've got this in the bag, don't we, Noir?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Yeah! We're gonna make the most delicious dish of all.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'm sure you're dying to know what kinds of dishes we'll produce,

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: so why don't you go ahead and press the timer next to you when you're ready?
Okay.
All the Nikkes head to their prep areas.
Everyone appears to be ready, so I press the button.
*Beep*
*Tick tock tick tock*
The time starts counting down from one hour.
Everyone delves into their cooking with a concentrated focus.
I don't want to just sit around for an hour twiddling my thumbs,
so let's see what kind of food they're cooking up.
Would you like to come with me, Lumi?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Now, who should we go to first?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hmm... should I put in some more ketchup?
I'll go to Emma first.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Eunhwa said I had to add something... what was it again?
What are you making?

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hey, Commander, Lumi.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Hehe, you'll find out soon enough.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I can tell you one thing for certain; you're going to love it.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: It's something very appropriate for Snowfield Hot Spring.
... I'm looking forward to seeing what it is.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Good!
*Blurbblurbblurb*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh dear, my water's boiling.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Sorry, Commander, but I've got to get back to cooking.
Good luck.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Emma delves back into her cooking.
Next, I think I'll go see...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Hmm...
I see Ludmilla deep in thought.
You haven't started cooking yet?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I'm still thinking of what to make.
You haven't decided yet?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: I want to make something simple...

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Oh, I've got it!

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Thanks, Servant.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Ludmilla hurriedly disappears elsewhere.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Noir, look at this! Isn't it cute?

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: It's shaped just like a rabbit!
Noir and Blanc are making sausages which are shaped like rabbits.
Very cute, indeed.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Pit Boss, Lumi! Isn't this really cute?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: We're gonna be using these for decoration.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Do garnishes factor into our score?
I... think so?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: In that case, we'll have to be sure to decorate it nicely.

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: Okay!
*Tak tak tak*
*Gurgle gurgle*
*Slurp*

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Mmm, tastes good.

You cook pretty well.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: Old-Timer!

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: It's only because

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I've made this dish for Belorta so many times before.
Looking forward to what you produce.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I'll make it as delicious as possible.
Everyone continues to prepare their wholly unique dishes.
One hour later.
*Beep, beep, beep, beep*

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Oh my, it's already been an hour?

lines.speaker: ludmilla_w
lines.text: Phew... I barely managed to finish.

lines.speaker: blanc_c
lines.text: Oh my gosh, our dish is so adorable!

lines.speaker: noir_c
lines.text: That's because you worked so hard on it.

lines.speaker: mica_w
lines.text: I just hope mine tastes good...
Their various dishes are lined up on the table:
Tempura fried rice paired with a mystery sauce.
A sumptuously baked apple pie.
A cute rabbit-shaped onigiri garnished with rabbit-shaped sausages.
And a colorful vegetable-filled curry rice.
Each dish looks more delicious than the last.
You all clearly took this competition very seriously.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Let us know which one is the best, Commander.
I start with the tempura fried rice.
*Crunch*
I think I need one more bite.
*Crunch*
The taste is fascinating and layered,
with a complex interplay of saltiness, freshness, and even a hint of sweetness all at once.
It's even better than I thought it would be.
Do you want a bite, Lumi?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
*Crunch*
What do you think?
Lumi continues to eat without saying a word.
Next, I take a bite of the inviting apple pie.
*Munch*
As I bite into the pie, I savor the crispy and flake crust accompanied by the sweet filling reminiscent of apple jam.
This would go wonderfully with a cup of tea.
Your turn, Lumi.

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
What's the verdict?
Lumi continues to eat without saying a word.
Next...
I take a bite of the rabbit-shaped onigiri.
Yummy.
The rice has been cooked to perfection, and somehow becomes more savory as I chew.
It's good enough to make me want to eat the entire thing.
Do you like this one, Lumi?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Lastly,
I try the curry rice, which has a tantalizingly seductive aroma.
As soon as I take a bite, I'm greeted with the rich and bold flavors that are produced as the ingredients blend together.
This one is delicious too, right?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Now that you've tasted each one, you need to pick your favorite.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Which dish did you like the most?
Well...
Which dish do you think is the best?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Um... could you rephrase that perhaps?

lines.speaker: lumi_01
lines.text: ... Yes.
Lumi says nothing further.
... I think I'll just have to speak on Lumi's behalf.

lines.text: Hehe, okay.
I think the winner has to be the...
Tempura fried rice.
Apple pie.
Rabbit onigiri.
Curry rice.
I raise up the plate containing the tempura fried rice, indicating it as my pick.
They were all delicious, but I slightly preferred this one above the others.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I made that one!
I particularly liked the sauce. Very unique.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: Eunhwa taught me to make it a few days ago. I'm glad you liked it, Commander.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: First you combine ketchup and soy sauce as a base, and I personally added some sweetness by mixing a dollop of whipped cream.

lines.speaker: emma
lines.text: I'll be sure to make it for you again sometime.

I raise up the plate containing the apple pie, indicating it as my pick.
